lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots arranged in at least five distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with regular vertical spacing between spot centroids.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Discrete vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular spot centroids, forming a repeating grid-like architecture on the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical luminance gradient with a light upper edge and a shadowed lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A small, dark, elongated silhouette is visible ventrally to the base of the pectoral fin; the rostrum and head region exhibit a significantly higher density of smaller, lower-diameter white spots compared to the mid-body flank.
